parsed_answer:
Variant rs1160312 is a single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) located in the *TTC19* gene. As of the latest available scientific literature up to July 2024, there is limited clinical significance reported specifically for rs1160312. 

This SNP has been studied in the context of genetic variation, but it does not appear to be strongly associated with any major clinical phenotype or disease in genome-wide association studies (GWAS) or other large-scale genetic analyses. It may be included in genetic databases or used as a marker in certain studies, but its functional role or impact on health outcomes remains unclear.

For the most accurate and up-to-date information, it is recommended to consult recent peer-reviewed publications or genetic databases such as the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) or the Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM).
